intro_zh: 沈阳是辽宁省省会，是清朝的发祥地，拥有故宫与皇陵，也是中国重要的工业重镇，被称为「共和国长子」。
intro_en: Shenyang, capital of Liaoning, is the birthplace of the Qing dynasty, home to an imperial palace and tombs. A major industrial center, it is known as the 'eldest son of the Republic'.
culture_zh: 满清皇城的厚重与东北的豪爽在这里交融，二人转的热闹与铁锅炖的香气是地道的东北烟火。
culture_en: The grandeur of the Manchu imperial city meets northeastern boldness; the fun of errenzhuan opera and the aroma of iron-pot stews are the city's true flavor.

attractions.desc_zh: 清初皇宫，规模仅次于北京故宫。
attractions.desc_en: The early-Qing imperial palace, second in scale only to Beijing's.

attractions.desc_zh: 张作霖、张学良父子的官邸，中西合璧。
attractions.desc_en: The residence of warlords Zhang Zuolin and Zhang Xueliang, blending East and West.

attractions.desc_zh: 清昭陵所在，古松环绕的皇家陵园。
attractions.desc_en: Home to the Qing Zhao Mausoleum, a royal tomb ringed by ancient pines.

foods.desc_zh: 酸甜酥脆的炸里脊，东北名菜。
foods.desc_en: Sweet-and-sour crispy fried pork—a Northeastern classic.

foods.desc_zh: 百年老字号的煸馅蒸饺，皮薄馅香。
foods.desc_en: A century-old brand of steamed dumplings with savory sautéed filling.

foods.desc_zh: 沈阳人钟爱的下酒小吃，做法多样。
foods.desc_en: A beloved Shenyang beer snack, prepared in many ways.
